propositions: The bugfix-size gate blocks changes with >150 non-test lines unless the bug has an acceptable plan-review attestation signed by an environment pinned in trusted_environments.yaml
A plan review signed by a developer's own unpinned environment returns verdict 'mismatch' and blocks, even when the plan review itself passed and is genuinely attested
No executable path exists for a contributor to obtain an attestation this gate accepts from an unpinned developer environment, making the criterion unsatisfiable for any locally-reviewed bug
The op-cert service has no client in the repo and no mechanism to persist returned envelopes as ticket attestations, so prod-attestation is not a viable remedy
The gate's failure message does not name a remedy, leaving authors to reverse-engineer the config and compose file to discover why a passing plan review is rejected
